steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Mighty big ruckus you've caused, Mr. Anthony.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Had I not known all about your plan in advance, I'm afraid not even I could've stopped you.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You're Jesselton?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: That's right. I'm Jesselton.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I'm sure you've noticed we've passed by each other in the prison a couple times, but allow me to introduce myself again.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: My name is Jesselton Williams, the very last obstacle to your prison break charade.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Where's Domma?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Right here.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Anthony, I'm sorry.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: I was waitin' here for you. I didn't expect this guy to barge into the clinic with the prisoners...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Domma...

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: This is such a gloomy place. It would be unbecoming of me to let a beautiful lady wait here all by herself.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: That's why I figured I'd offer her my protection.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Mr. Jesselton...

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Oh, Ms. Robin, it looks like I was expecting a little too much from you. What a disappointment.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Or perhaps you never tried to kill him in the first place?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: She failed, and your lackeys couldn't hurt me.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Yet you spared her life. I must say, you are a fine gentleman, Mr. Anthony.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Save it.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Very well. Let us get straight to the point.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Mr. Anthony, if you don't want this young lady to die, please step over here.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Ms. Kafka, I would appreciate it if you would stay right there.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I can tell you're the opportunistic kind. Please try not to do anything that would put Ms. Domma in harm's way.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Yes, just stand right there.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: All of you, surround him.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Anthony, don't listen to him!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: It's okay, Domma. We are going to save you.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I have to hand it to you, Mr. Anthony. It's admirable that you are able to stay calm even in such a precarious situation.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I'm sure you know what it is that I want, and you also know that I won't spare you out of compassion.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Here's my suggestion. Abandon the lady, abandon your affectations, and come fight me.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You're wasting your breath.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I wonder how long you can keep this up.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: And you, Ms. Robin.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I would like you to kill Mr. Anthony. After all, you still have a job to do.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: It doesn't matter what kind of agreement you've made with Mr. Anthony or if you've had a change of heart, for whatever reason.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: If you want the money, and if you want to save your father, then this is your last, best hope.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Why the hesitation? Did Anthony promise you a blank check? Or have you grown soft on him after all this time?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Last chance, Ms. Robin.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Think of your father. Think of how your life is in tatters. Think of your future, your wish.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: If I were you, I wouldn't hesitate.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: What are you trying to do?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: What am I trying to do?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Isn't it obvious? If all I wanted was to kill you, I've had plenty of chances here.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: But that would be a li'l bit boring, wouldn't it?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I've never found killing someone all that much fun, Mr. Anthony.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: But I really enjoy those moments when a person is faced with no choice but to abandon their past.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: That is why I lured Ms. Robin here. I long to see her change. I crave for her fall.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: And I thirst for your change as well. I thirst for the moment you finally lose your cool and bare your fangs, all for the sake of your family, your goals!

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I mean it, Mr. Anthony. Take off your gentleman's facade.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Think of your family. Think of all you've been through, the humiliations you've faced. Think of the reason you're breaking out of this prison.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Do you really want to die here?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Do you really want to throw your life away for a woman you've only known a few years?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Stand up, Mr. Anthony. Push Ms. Robin aside, forget Ms. Domma, come at me and kill me!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Not everyone out there is like you, Jesselton.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: You should know that you aren't all that special either, Anthony.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I'll give you five seconds, Ms. Robin. If you don't act, I'll do it myself, and you'll die here with him.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Five.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Ms. Robin, you have yet to pay off your father's medical bills, and Mr. Anthony is penniless.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Anthony, I...

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Four.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Mr. Anthony, your parents are having a miserable time in prison. They're being ostracized.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Father, mother...

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Three.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Anthony, don't worry about me! You can't die here!

steps.name: Prisoner A
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Prisoner A
steps.text: Guess what, bitch? You ain't killing yourself on my watch.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Ro...bin... don't...

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Well, Ms. Domma is quite a bit more fiery than I expected. How admirable.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Alas, it didn't go as she planned.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Jes-sel-ton.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Now that's the face I want to see, Mr. Anthony. Wonderful.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I'm curious. What is it that fuels your conviction?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Do you think your death can buy my sympathy for everyone else here?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Are your principles worth that much to you?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Perhaps you still have a card up your sleeve?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I've done much to betray my principles in this prison.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I sweet-talked the jailers, stuck up for Barton, fought those I didn't want to fight, and lived a life I didn't want to live.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: This has nothing to do with principles.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: This only has to do with me.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I won't sacrifice Domma for my own ends. That's all there is to it.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Even though your family is still waiting for you?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You have no right to talk about my family.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Even though you have revenge to take and questions you need answered?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: None of that is more important than the life of a friend.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Even if it ends up killing you?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Even if it ends up killing me.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Anthony...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You have to think everything through and make your own choices. Then, you need to take responsibility for each of those choices.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Otherwise, you'll never be able to take your fate into your own hands.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You must scrutinize yourself and think about what it is that you want to do.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Anthony...

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: How regrettable.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Well then. Two.

a.text: Robin finally takes a step forward.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: One.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Ms. Robin, I understand your struggle, but you have a decision to make.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Anthony.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: No matter what you end up doing, don't regret your decision, Robin.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Right.

a.text: She swings the knife in her hand.
Which then flies toward its target.

steps.name: Prisoner A
steps.text: Gurghh!

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Anthony, leave Domma to me!

steps.name: Prisoner B
steps.text: Tsk! You prick!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Heh, you two sure kept me waiting!

steps.name: Prisoner B
steps.text: When did you...?!

steps.name: Prisoner B
steps.text: ...Euggh...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Anthony!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: *Roars*!!!

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: So this is the trick you had up your sleeve.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: You knew Ms. Robin was on your side?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Perhaps your offer wasn't enticing enough.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Are you sure about this, Ms. Robin?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: From where I'm standing, you have chosen a path that has no future.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: It's true that if it wasn't for the Simons, my father wouldn't have turned out like that, but it's his fault for not getting back up on his feet.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I knew that. I just didn't want to accept it.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: And I... really don't want to do that either.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Anthony promised to come up with something to raise money for my father's medical bills.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: But that doesn't actually matter.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I've decided I'm not going to kill Anthony, and even if he doesn't help me, I'll come up with something else myself.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: And if my father dies before I get the money, then I...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Then I'll kill myself and apologize to him in hell.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: That's my decision.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Beautiful. Beautiful indeed.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: What a beautiful resolve, Ms. Robin.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I suppose you've made your decision. You want to turn your back on our agreement because of that resolve.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Very well. Who am I to blame you for that? I should applaud you for making that decision, even.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: That said, I still have to point out one thing.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: When I said this path had no future, I didn't mean you won't have much of a future after your little jailbreak.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I mean it all ends right here and now.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: There isn't a future where you make it out of this prison alive.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I guess we'll have to see about that.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: No, no, no.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I have to admit. You are very strong, Mr. Anthony.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: As for me, killing and violence aren't exactly my thing.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: That's why Ms. Domma was only the first step in my attempt to stop you from 'seeing about that'.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: As for the second step—

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Ugh... agh...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Waagh!

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Anthony, Kafka, are you two okay?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'm... fine.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: You haven't forgotten the shackles on you, have you?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Dammit, this guy's thought everything through.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I appreciate your compliment, Ms. Kafka.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You asshole, you've been lying to Robin from the start!

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: No, no, no. I just like to have more than one option.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Had Ms. Robin gone through with the deal and succeeded, it would've saved me quite a bit of trouble.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: And if she failed, as you can see, I've prepared a fall-back for her.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: You can't say I planned for all this without putting myself in her shoes.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Easy for you to say, but you dragged her into this mess.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Haha, I never denied I wanted to see her struggle, did I?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: However, Ms. Kafka, you are very much in the know yourself. Think about it. Do you think she could've raised enough money for her father's surgery, had I not dragged her into this mess?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I think it's extraordinarily unlikely.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: See? You can't argue with me on that.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Hmph... I have to admit. She has a lot more to gain... by helping you out.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: But she didn't help you.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: And that's more than enough for me!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: *Roars*!!!

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Still trying to fight despite the circumstances?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Very well, then allow me to personally tear apart that last delusion.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Anthony, I'll back you up!

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Tsk, I ain't quite as strong as Anthony, y'know...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Huh... You guys watch out! His hand...

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: His hand turned black!

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Ahh, how heartwarming.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: To think I get to crush this emotional get-together...

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: It just fills me with delight, Anthony!
